title: Exotic Egyptian Lentil Flatbread
description: A charred, fluffy, and quick-fix Egyptian dish featuring red food coloring, this Jain-friendly flatbread is perfect for a snack or light meal, cooked to perfection on a comal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the red lentils, all-purpose flour, red food coloring, salt, sugar, and active dry yeast.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Knead the batter for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Divide the batter into 4 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a comal over medium-high heat and brush with olive oil.
Place a flatbread on the comal and cook for 1-2 minutes, until it starts to char and puff up.
Flip the flatbread and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until it is golden brown and crispy.
Serve the flatbreads hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
